question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Resilient."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Resilient."**
 
• It means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties or toughness. (रोग, आघात, परिवर्तन आदि से सँभलने में समर्थ; प्रतिस्‍कंदी, लचीला)
 
 
• **Example**: *She is a **resilient**__ person who bounced back from a major setback in her career.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Amplified" **is the correct spelling and means to make something louder or more intense. (विद्युत उपकरणों द्वारा ध्वनि-शक्ति में वृद्धि करना)
 
• **Option 3: "Obsolete"** is the correct spelling and means something that is no longer in use or outdated. (प्रयोग की दृष्टि से पुरानी पड़ चुकी (क्‍योंकि उसका स्‍थान नई वस्‍तु ने ले लिया है); प्रयोगबाह्य, अब अप्रचलित, अव्‍यवहृत)
 
• **Option 4: "Hallucinating"** is the correct spelling and means to experience hallucinations or seeing things that are not there. (मतिभ्रम का अनुभव करना या ऐसी चीजें देखना जो वहां नहीं हैं)
